note: CRIM publishes the island-wide Parcelario (about 1.25M parcels, incl. San Lorenzo, 72129). Its ArcGIS REST host sigejp.pr.gov returns 'Service crim/crim_parcelas/MapServer not started' for the MapServer, layer and query endpoints, and the sigejp crim folder lists no services. The legacy satasgis.crimpr.net Parcelas/Tasaciones/ParcelasEtiquetas MapServer URLs cited by the CRIM web map return 404 or fail to connect. The gis.pr.gov WFS (geoserver2.pr.gov pr_geodata) has no parcel feature type. No other public queryable San Lorenzo parcel polygon service was found; Regrid has parcels but is commercial.
